title: Separability of compatible strict-henselization residue elements
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-weil-pbc-compatible-strict-henselization-residue-polynomial and an algebra structure from the second residue field to k′ whose algebraMap equals the embedding induced by ρB, every image of a first residue-field element in k′ is separable over the second residue field.

proof.text: Use the single-model residue comparison for A to obtain s, f:κ(s)→κA, separability, and a factorization of its closed-point structural morphism.

Compose the factorization with ι and ρA; rewrite with hρA, hι and hρB. The resulting field point agrees with ρB followed by the second closed-point structural morphism and g. Apply SpecToEquivOfField, transport along the equality of image points, and cancel the monomorphism fromSpecResidueField s to construct c:κ(s)→κB with a∘f=b∘c. This is the proved private lemma residue_factorization_descends.

Install the algebra structures from f, a∘f, and c. The compatibility equation and hAlgebra give IsScalarTower κ(s) κB k′. Apply IsSeparable.map to the injective κ(s)-algebra map a, then IsSeparable.tower_top to enlarge the base to κB.

lean.statement:
theorem Etale.compatibleStrictHenselization_residue_isSeparable
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} {g : T ⟶ S}
    {k k' Ω A B : Type u} [Field k] [IsSepClosed k] [Field k'] [IsSepClosed k']
    [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [HenselianLocalRing A] [HenselianLocalRing B]
    [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)]
    (σ : Spec (.of k) ⟶ S) (τ : Spec (.of k') ⟶ T)
    (ι : Spec (.of k') ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (hι : ι ≫ σ = τ ≫ g)
    (ν : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of k'))
    (eA : Spec (.of A) ≅ strictHenselizationScheme (ν ≫ ι ≫ σ))
    (eB : Spec (.of B) ≅ strictHenselizationScheme (ν ≫ τ))
    (ρA : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)))
    (ρB : Spec (.of k') ⟶ Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)))
    (hρA : ρA ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue A)) ≫
      eA.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap (ν ≫ ι ≫ σ) = σ)
    (hρB : ρB ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue B)) ≫
      eB.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap (ν ≫ τ) = τ)
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) k']
    (hAlgebra : algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) k' = (Spec.preimage ρB).hom) :
    ∀ x : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A,
      IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)
        ((Spec.preimage (ι ≫ ρA)).hom x)
